title: Deleting a term another user just put a customer on is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a second user, user B, signed in with the "Admin" role in a second browser (you are signed in as an Admin in the first).
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Create customer A for this test, on COD.
  • Start with your browser showing the Credit Terms page and user B's browser showing Edit Customer for customer A.
custom_steps:
1. In your browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  3. In user B's browser, set Credit Terms to term A.
  4. In user B's browser, click Save.
  5. In your browser, click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The delete confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • Term A is selected in user B's Edit Customer.

Step 4:

  • Customer A is saved on term A.

Step 5:

  • The app's error alert shows "Used by 1 customer. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." The confirmation stays open and term A is not deleted.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • Story 2, Error Handling: “If a save is refused, the app's standard error alert shows the reason, using these exact texts: "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first." (deactivating or deleting the default); "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." (editing or deleting a term in use); "Always available. COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated."; "Pick an active term other than Credit Hold." (making an inactive term or Credit Hold the default); "Credit term not found." (the term was deleted meanwhile). The delete confirmation stays open when the delete is refused.”
  • S2-E2: “If a term becomes in use, becomes the default, or is changed by another user after the page loaded, the save is refused with the reason in S2 Error Handling, and the page keeps its state.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Edit or delete of a term in use refused (server) | "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." | Standard error alert”
